name: ui-accordion
description: Bootstrap accordion on native <details>: exclusive or always open, theme colours, small, flush, gap, custom icons, open/close all.

descriptions.--bs-accordion-padding-x: Horizontal padding of header and body.
descriptions.--bs-accordion-padding-y: Vertical padding of header and body.
descriptions.--bs-accordion-transition-property: Properties of the header animated on open.
descriptions.--bs-accordion-panel-transition-property: Properties of the panel animated on open and close.
descriptions.--bs-accordion-panel-transition-timing: Timing function of the panel animation.
descriptions.--bs-accordion-btn-color: Text colour of a closed header.
descriptions.--bs-accordion-btn-icon-transform: Transform of the icon of an open item.
descriptions.--bs-accordion-active-color: Text colour of an open header.
descriptions.--bs-accordion-font-size: Font size (unset: inherited; sm sets it).
descriptions.--bs-accordion-btn-padding-x: Horizontal padding of the header (unset: padding-x).
descriptions.--bs-accordion-btn-padding-y: Vertical padding of the header (unset: padding-y).
descriptions.--bs-accordion-body-padding-x: Horizontal padding of the body (unset: padding-x).
descriptions.--bs-accordion-body-padding-y: Vertical padding of the body (unset: padding-y).
